# Ten Pretty Nails

> Nail salon based in Pflugerville, Texas. Spa pedicures, full sets, gel, solar nails, silk wraps and hand-painted art at 1420 Wells Branch Pkwy. Walk-ins welcome, and plenty of regulars who've been coming for years.

- Phone: (512) 251-6464
- Based in: Pflugerville, TX
- Nearby areas: Pflugerville, Wells Branch, Round Rock, North Austin, Hutto
- Google rating: 3.6 from 176 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/ten-pretty-nails/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/ten-pretty-nails/book.html

## Services
- Spa pedicures & manicures: A relaxing pedicure in the leather massage chairs, plus a manicure while you're here.
- Acrylic & solar full sets: Coffin, almond or square, shaped how you like them, with fill-ins when it's time. Solar sets too.
- Gel & shellac color: Glossy, long-lasting color, from soft nudes to bright neon.
- Nail art & airbrush: Bring your idea and the team brings it to life, from 3D flowers and snowflakes to holiday sets.
- Silk wraps & repairs: Silk wraps to strengthen natural nails, and help for nails that need saving.
- Waxing & eyebrows: Quick brow and face waxing while you're in for your nails. Look for the WAXING neon in the window.

## About
Ten Pretty Nails is a neighborhood nail salon at 1420 Wells Branch Pkwy #270 in Pflugerville, in the shopping center next to Ace Cash Express. Look for the blue and red 10 PRETTY NAILS sign, the WAXING and OPEN neon and the pink specials board out front. Our card says it simply: professional nail full service, appointment or walk-in welcome. Inside it's leather massage pedicure chairs, granite nail tables and a whole wall of polish colors. The window lists what we do: airbrush, silk wraps, spa pedis, solar nails and gel nails. Clients mention the clean salon and careful sanitation, and some have been coming for years. One regular of more than eight years says she'd drive the extra distance even if she moved, and one family brings three generations.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday 9 AM to 7 PM, Sunday 11 AM to 5 PM. Holiday hours may differ.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, appointments or walk-ins are welcome. We get busy, so on weekends and evenings call (512) 251-6464 first to check the wait or save a spot.
- Q: Where is Ten Pretty Nails?
  A: 1420 Wells Branch Pkwy #270, Pflugerville, TX 78660, in the shopping center next to Ace Cash Express.
- Q: How much is a pedicure or full set?
  A: See the specials board on our Services page for current specials. Prices for other services depend on length and design, so just ask when you call or walk in.
- Q: Can you do a design from a photo?
  A: Yes. Bring a photo or describe your idea, from 3D flowers and studs to snowflakes and holiday art, and the team will paint it for you.
- Q: Do you do silk wraps, solar nails and airbrush?
  A: Yes. Silk wraps, solar nails, gel nails, shellac, airbrush and spa or deluxe pedicures are all on the menu.
- Q: How can I pay?
  A: Credit cards and Apple Pay are accepted.
- Q: Can I ask for a specific nail tech?
  A: Of course. Clients ask for Kevin, Hannah and Linda by name. Just mention who you'd like when you call or walk in.
